name: I Am Hero
summary:
IamHero is an interactive virtual reality platform designed for children and young people. Through immersive environments and gamified activities, it offers experiences focused on skills such as attention, working memory, planning, impulse management, and coordination.

IamHero collects data exclusively related to interactions within the app, such as response times, activity results, and progression through the different scenarios. This information is used to display the user’s progress and adjust the level
